summary_md: **Mauro ([@mauropm](https://x.com/mauropm/status/2115825447057363125))** shares **sparkLimiter**, a script to cap the GPU clock on NVIDIA DGX Spark machines, reporting that a 1900 MHz cap dropped his Spark's temperature by 3 °C ([MiaAI-Lab/sparkLimiter](https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/sparkLimiter)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - MiaAI-Lab/sparkLimiter: Cap the GPU clock on NVIDIA DGX Sparks across all your machines, persistently

relevance: Directly useful thermal tuning for Richard's DGX Spark.
